save_config.confirm_body: Klipper writes the pending changes to printer.cfg and restarts. Heaters turn off and the printer has to home again.
save_config.changed_more: {{list}}, and {{more}} more, changed since Klipper started.
save_config.other_change: A removed profile or another change is waiting to be written to printer.cfg.

mesh.title: Bed mesh
mesh.hint_3d: Drag to turn the bed, scroll or pinch to zoom. X0 Y0 is the front left corner, as you face the printer.
mesh.hint_map: Seen from above, back of the bed at the top. X0 Y0 is the front left corner, as you face the printer.
mesh.empty: No mesh loaded. Load a profile or calibrate one.
mesh.problem_points_measured_one: {{count}} problem point in the mesh measured {{time}}
mesh.problem_points_measured_other: {{count}} problem points in the mesh measured {{time}}
mesh.retries_one: A probe point needed retries in this mesh, {{list}}. Check the plate there.
mesh.retries_other: Probe points needed retries in this mesh, {{list}}. Check the plate there.
mesh.load_body: The printer is printing. Load profile {{name}} anyway?
mesh.remove_body: Klipper forgets the profile now. printer.cfg keeps it until you save the config.
mesh.clear_body: The printer is printing. Clear the bed mesh anyway?
mesh.name: Name
mesh.help_calibrate: Calibrate probes the whole bed and saves it as profile default, replacing it. QIDI's BED_MESH_CALIBRATE checks the mesh area first.
mesh.help_clear: Clear unloads the mesh; no profile changes.
mesh.help_save_as: Save as keeps the loaded mesh under a new name. Profiles reach printer.cfg with Save config.
mesh.remove_hint: If saving as something other than {{name}}, you can choose to also remove the {{name}} profile.
mesh.heatmap_label: Bed mesh heat map, back of the bed at the top

calibrate.need_home: Most of these tools need the printer homed.
calibrate.z_tilt_hint: Probes both sides of the bed and turns the Z motors until the gantry is level with it.
calibrate.corner_hint: Check bed screws homes, runs Z tilt adjust, then probes at each screw.
calibrate.results_hint: 01:15 means one full turn and 15 minutes, as on a clock face. Turn each screw the way its arrow shows, then check again.
calibrate.no_results: Results show here after the check.
calibrate.by_hand: Or level by hand with a sheet of paper at each screw.
calibrate.endstops_empty: Use the refresh button to update endstop status.
calibrate.endstops_note: The nozzle is the Z probe. QUERY_PROBE can't check its load cell; use the load-cell check instead.
calibrate.accuracy_hint_center: Homes, moves to the middle of the bed at Z10, and probes the same spot again and again. The range and deviation show how repeatable the probe is.
calibrate.accuracy_hint_here: Probes the same spot again and again. The range and deviation show how repeatable the probe is.
calibrate.z_offset_hint: PROBE_CALIBRATE probes the bed, then you lower the nozzle onto a sheet of paper. The difference becomes the probe's Z offset, saved with Save config.

load_cell.title: Nozzle load-cell check
load_cell.result_ok: Your load cell readings look correct.
load_cell.result_bad: Your load cell did not respond as expected.
load_cell.result_unclear: There was not enough difference between pressing and not pressing to tell, or the test stopped early.
load_cell.intro: The printer won't move, heat, or change calibration. It takes about 40 seconds.
load_cell.rule_idle: The printer must be idle with all heaters off, and the nozzle and bed below 40 °C.
load_cell.rule_reach: Make sure you can reach the nozzle and it's clear of the bed. Don't home to prepare.
load_cell.rule_prompts: Follow the prompts here: press lightly upward on the nozzle only when told to. Never force it.
load_cell.press_hint: Press lightly upward only at PRESS, and let go when told to stop.
load_cell.about: Checks that the nozzle load cell, which is both the probe and the Z endstop, responds to light pressure. No motion.
load_cell.metrics: Signal change {{change}} counts (needed {{needed}}); baseline noise {{noise}}; release error {{release}}.
load_cell.caution: A detected response does not verify the homing trigger. For any other result, don't press harder, and don't home or probe until the cause is understood.

shaper.title: Input shaper
shaper.confirm_empty: Empty the bed first: take off any print and anything loose.
shaper.confirm_body: The toolhead shakes hard at the test point for about two minutes per axis, moving up to about 20 mm either side. Then Klipper picks a shaper for each axis and applies it until it restarts; Save config keeps it.
shaper.confirm_body_home: The printer homes first. The toolhead shakes hard at the test point for about two minutes per axis, moving up to about 20 mm either side. Then Klipper picks a shaper for each axis and applies it until it restarts; Save config keeps it.
shaper.unshaped: Input shaping is off for this axis now
shaper.not_saved: No input shaper calibration is saved. Until there is, homing keeps acceleration at QIDI's 10000 mm/s² for leveling and mesh moves.
shaper.empty_bed: Empty the bed before calibrating. The toolhead shakes hard during the test.

helpers.manual_hint: Lower the nozzle until it just grips a sheet of paper, then Accept. The steps below move Z by that many millimetres.
helpers.screws_hint: Press Adjusted if a significant adjustment is necessary on the current screw; otherwise, press Accept to continue.

soak.title: Bed soak
soak.intro: Measures the bed from cold while it heats, to show how long the bed and chamber take to reach temperature and how long the bed keeps moving after that. Times count from when the heaters turn on.
soak.stop_body: Stop the bed soak test? The heaters it turned on turn off now, and the results so far are kept.
soak.busy: The printer is busy. Start the test once it's idle.
soak.warm_both: Bed is {{bed}} °C and chamber is {{chamber}} °C. Let them cool for a true cold start.
soak.warm_bed: Bed is {{bed}} °C. Let it cool for a true cold start.
soak.warm_chamber: Chamber is {{chamber}} °C. Let it cool for a true cold start.
soak.last_settled: Last finished run at these temperatures ({{date}}) reached temperature in {{bed}} and stopped moving after {{settled}}.
soak.last_moving: Last finished run at these temperatures ({{date}}) reached temperature in {{bed}} and was still moving after {{limit}} min.
soak.settled_tip_one: Ends the test once the bed moves less than {{speed}} µm per minute for {{count}} mesh in a row. Otherwise it runs to the time limit.
soak.settled_tip_other: Ends the test once the bed moves less than {{speed}} µm per minute for {{count}} meshes in a row. Otherwise it runs to the time limit.
soak.stop_settled: Stop when the bed stops moving
soak.ends_settled_one: Ends once the bed moves less than {{speed}} µm per minute for {{count}} mesh in a row, or at the time limit.
soak.ends_settled_other: Ends once the bed moves less than {{speed}} µm per minute for {{count}} meshes in a row, or at the time limit.
soak.summary_change: Height {{height}} mm, shape {{shape}} mm since the cold mesh
soak.heaters_kept_on: heaters kept on at the end
soak.no_result: This run has no result, as Klipper stopped before the test ended.
soak.repeat_points_one: {{list}} had a probe problem in more than one mesh.
soak.repeat_points_other: {{list}} had probe problems in more than one mesh.
soak.jumped_one: Probe readings jumped in mesh {{list}}, which isn't used.
soak.jumped_other: Probe readings jumped in meshes {{list}}, which aren't used.
soak.check_plate: Check the plate, then run the test again for a clean result.
soak.charts_wait: The charts start once the cold mesh is measured.
soak.chart_movement: Bed movement since the cold mesh
soak.took_tries_one: Took {{count}} try, samples up to {{um}} µm apart.
soak.took_tries_other: Took {{count}} tries, samples up to {{um}} µm apart.
soak.out_of_line: Out of line with the rest of the bed by {{change}}.
soak.problem_retried_one: retried {{meshes}}, up to {{count}} try, {{um}} µm apart
soak.problem_retried_other: retried {{meshes}}, up to {{count}} tries, {{um}} µm apart
soak.problem_out_of_line: out of line {{meshes}}, by up to {{change}}
soak.problem_jump: not used, probe readings jumped {{um}} µm
soak.preview_shape: {{mesh}} of the bed soak, change from the cold mesh (shape)
soak.preview_shape_height: {{mesh}} of the bed soak, change from the cold mesh (shape and height)
soak.top_view: Top view, back of the bed at the top. Blue is lower than the cold mesh, red is higher.
soak.compare_hint: Tick up to three runs to compare them.
